name: AFR 101 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 04，联系离场 119.7，应答机 2521。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 1700 meters, departure Runway 04, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往巴黎，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 1700 米，离场使用 Runway 04，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2521，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: You decide that 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为由于重量过大，10700 米不可接受，询问 9500 米是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, 10,700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，由于重量过大，10,700 米不可接受，9500 米是否可用？

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，巡航高度改为9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Z4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04via Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway Z four and A, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, give way to B737 vacating on E3, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，给正在 E3 脱离的 B737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: give way to Boeing 737 vacating on E tree, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A niner, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给正在 E3 脱离的 Boeing 737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters on QNH1015.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，雷达识别，左转直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, climb to 6000 meters, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，爬升至 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite climb until passing 3900, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your left engine has failed at 6000 meters, make an urgency call to ATC and request to descend and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的左发突然在 6000 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们的左发在 6000 米失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4,200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，收到你的 PAN 呼叫，下降至 4,200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。
